notes: Governing documents: BPPM 60.56 (Revised 10-17) is the faculty leave policy and the Faculty Manual 2017-18 (III.C.3.f, III.D) is the faculty handbook; both cover tenure-stream faculty, so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document does not apply). The HRS pages are summaries; the modified-duties form refers to unsaved guidelines.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave: a parent's paid time comes only from own sick leave (c4) and, for annual-appointment faculty, annual leave (c5). Protected leave: FMLA (c1) and the Washington Family Leave Act parental leave (c2), which BPPM 60.56 says 'may be in addition to' pregnancy/childbirth disability leave (c3).

Birth parent chain: pregnancy disability leave c3 (6-8 weeks, certified) with FMLA c1 (12 workweeks) running from its start -> WA FLA parental leave c2 (up to 12 weeks) from the doctor's release; pay only from own balances (c4 concurrent with FMLA).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA c1 (12 workweeks) with WA FLA parental leave c2 running concurrently from the start; own sick leave c4 alongside. (c2's consecutive_after link to c3 carries roles ['birth'].)

U8: Emergency leave (Faculty Manual III.D.14; BPPM 60.56) covers death in the family or a 'comparable emergency', defined as severe illness of a family member 'when not otherwise eligible for coverage under FML'; it serves only members not eligible for FML, so it is recorded here, not as a component (5 working days, extendable to 10 with the provost).

Not components: professional leave and retraining leave (purpose-limited sabbaticals); faculty leave with pay for official duties; civil, jury, testimony, military, voting, faith, life-giving, domestic-violence and suspended-operations leave; holidays and personal holiday; reasonable accommodation for disability (Faculty Manual III.B, BPPM 60.21); phased retirement; benefit-continuation rule (eight hours of paid leave a month for up to four months of pregnancy/childbirth disability or parental LWOP), recorded in c3's note.

Indefinite (non-tenure-track) faculty: six weeks of sick leave for childbearing or adoption without physician verification (c15); their leave without pay (Faculty Manual V.G.9) is limited to the current appointment and is not separately coded.

Documents cited but not saved: RCW 49.78 (Family Leave); Washington State Family Leave Act Overview and Q&A; BPPM 60.58 Shared Leave; BPPM 60.57 Civil Service Employee Leave; BPPM 60.21 Reasonable Accommodation; Faculty Modified Duties Guidelines; HRS FMLA implementing procedures and Disability Services advisory guidelines; Lactation Guidelines; Administrative Professional Handbook; PEBB benefit plan details; BPPM 60.63, 60.19, 55.49, 60.41, 60.72, 60.76, 50.40, 60.40, 60.34, 60.44, 60.11, 60.25, SPPM 2.30; the Washington pregnancy accommodation law (unnamed).
